body:
PR #2792 head 3fa76e8673 (fix 63fc77e7d2 + merge of main; no force-push).
1. all_author_sessions(root, head_branch): work leases + harness ledger records on the head branch still author; only harness leases on OTHER branches drop. Both callers (ship_approval_policy, review_recorder_authors) pass the branch.
2. Fail-closed tests: spec_less_pr_ignores_a_harness_lease_on_another_branch (ships) and spec_less_pr_refuses_the_harness_lease_on_its_head_branch (AuthorSession, live and ledger-only).
3. RecorderIdentity::current binds by actual cwd only (project_root dropped); new recorder_binds_leases_by_cwd_not_project_root; PR-2791 test now documents the remaining main-checkout-cwd binding via with_context.
4. (Refs:BUG-1) colon/no-space parses; case added.
Gates: check-ci-fast 33/33 ok, test-touched 484 ok. Note: bug_1918 unrecognised_agent_is_bound_by_its_session_leader flaked once in a parallel run (passes alone and in 2 reruns; uses no leases, looks like an env race).
subject: PR-2792 round 2
